shortcut_name: base-4 positional collapse of the noise cascade
evidence: The solution explicitly says "compute weights w[i]" and uses a "symbolic simulation" because "we only need the total contribution of each x_i to the final sum."
affordance_in_statement: The cascade occurs in n-1 sequential steps. For every j strictly greater than k, the value of A_j is increased by 3 × A_k. After all n-1 steps are completed, the final interference metric M is the sum of all n accumulators.
removal_suggestion: Re-present the same cascade as an opaque, explicitly specified hardware transfer procedure or fixed transfer operator, rather than exposing the repeated forward propagation and its easily recognized powers of four. This preserves the metric but prevents the shortcut from being immediately visible in the statement.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Linearizes the cascade into per-position weights, recognizing that the objective is dominated by earlier band assignments and can be optimized as a weighted coloring problem.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The cascade repeatedly adds 3 × A_k to every later accumulator, and M is the sum of all final accumulators.

common_affordance: The explicitly stated repeated forward cascade makes each input band contribute a positional power-of-four weight, reducing the metric to a lexicographically dominated weighted 3-coloring objective.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: Uses plain backtracking over color assignments and performs a full scan of all constraints for each validity check, causing exponential search and TLE at n up to 40.
Attempts only a bipartite two-coloring, using the opposite color 4 - c, so it rejects or mishandles valid graphs requiring three bands.
Uses a one-pass greedy three-coloring without backtracking or feasibility checks; a locally available band can lead to a dead end even when a valid 3-coloring exists.

recommended_edit: Replace the explicit accumulator-propagation paragraph with an equivalent transfer-operator specification whose entries are defined procedurally and whose positional powers are not apparent from the prose; retain the exact same computed M and output requirements.
regression_risk: This may not defeat a solver that symbolically reconstructs the transfer operator from the exact procedure, but it should specifically remove the immediate weight/lexicographic cue used by gpt-oss-120b without restoring the already-defeated coloring algorithms.
